overview: OpenAI expands model lineup and adds sales-focused plugins; Amazon and Google secure large non‑voting stakes in Anthropic post‑IPO; Nvidia’s startup portfolio swells to $65 B amid leadership transition concerns.

top.title: Introducing GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
top.summary: OpenAI announced GPT‑6.2 Astra and Sol, claiming improved professional output, coding, and computer use at lower cost across ChatGPT Work, Codex, and API, signaling incremental model upgrades rather than a generational leap.

top.title: Introducing ChatGPT for Sales
top.summary: OpenAI introduced a Sales plugin and over 30 partner plugins for ChatGPT, enabling users to research prospects, draft pitches, update CRMs, and advance deals, aiming to embed AI deeper into sales workflows.

top.title: Amazon and Google will together own nearly 30% of Anthropic after its IPO
top.summary: Anthropic disclosed that Amazon will hold 14.7% and Google 13.7% of non‑voting shares after its IPO, with Amazon retaining conversion options that could raise its stake to 23.8%, while both firms commit to extensive cloud spend.

top.title: Nvidia’s startup stakes ballooned to $65B, but Huang’s exit puts future deals in doubt
top.summary: Nvidia reported its equity in AI startups now totals $65.5 B, up from $22 B, after $16 B invested this quarter, but future funding may slow under new interim CEO following Jensen Huang’s departure.

top.title: Copilot is "the new OS for work," and now Office runs inside of it
top.summary: Microsoft launched general availability of Word, Excel, and PowerPoint inside Copilot, positioning the AI assistant as a new operating system for work, with autonomous agents, a knowledge layer, and collaborative workspaces.

top.title: Amazon SageMaker AI real-time endpoints now support KV cache aware routing
top.summary: Amazon SageMaker AI added KV‑aware routing for real‑time endpoints, directing requests to instances with relevant cached prompts, improving latency for multi‑turn LLM applications compared to prior prefix‑aware routing.
